issue.title: Bundle known FIA/FCBH pericope set JSON in the APK (bandwidth-first seed)
issue.body:
## Summary

Mobile users often have poor / metered network. Pericope **boundaries** (FIA / FCBH-style sets) are mostly static reference data. Shipping known sets inside the APK lets post-login sync seed SQLite with **zero runtime bytes** for those sets.

This ticket owns **asset packaging + setId mapping + loader**. [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) owns schema, sync orchestration, and queries that **consume** the loader.

Companion network path (when set is unknown or version mismatches): [fluent-api#309](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/309) — `GET /pericope-sets/{id}` + ETag.

## Why not only API sync

[#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) previously planned one chapter GET per assignment. That burns RTT × N on flaky networks. Even a bulk chapter API still downloads set boundaries over the air. Bundled known sets + conditional set refresh is the bandwidth-first hybrid we want.

## Scope

### In scope

- Identify which fluent-api `pericope_set` ids/names ship in v1 (FIA and/or FCBH — confirm with product / API owners).
- Confirm license / redistribution rights for shipping those JSON (or derived) files in the Android APK.
- APK size budget (document target; prefer compressed assets; consider OT/NT split if needed).
- Asset layout under something like `assets/pericope-sets/` + a stable map: `pericopeSetId` and/or set `name` → asset module.
- Pure loader API used by sync (e.g. `loadBundledPericopeSet(setId): SetSnapshot | null`) — no HTTP inside the loader.
- Version / content-hash embedded in the asset (or sidecar) so #438 can compare to SQLite `version` / `etag` and skip reseed when equal.
- Unit tests for map lookup, parse, and “unknown setId → null”.
- Doc note in AGENT_ONBOARDING or a short `docs/guides/` note: how to refresh bundled sets in a release.

### Out of scope

- SQLite schema / sync step / chapter queries — [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438).
- fluent-api endpoint implementation — [fluent-api#309](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/309).
- Bible/Record UI (#408 / #409).
- Shipping full FIA *media* (audio/images) — this is **boundary JSON only** (verse ranges + titles).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Product/API agree which set ids are in the v1 APK.
- [ ] Licensing clearance documented on the ticket (or explicit “blocked on legal” with owner).
- [ ] Bundled assets land in the repo/APK; size vs budget recorded in the PR.
- [ ] Loader returns typed set snapshot for mapped ids and `null` for unmapped.
- [ ] Asset includes a version/hash consumable by #438 sync.
- [ ] Unit tests cover mapping + parse.
- [ ] CI gates pass.

## How to verify

1. Fresh install, offline: #438 sync path can seed a mapped set from assets (integration or manual with airplane mode once #438 wiring exists).
2. Unmapped setId: loader returns null; sync falls through to API (when available) without crashing.
3. APK size delta reported on the PR.

## Related

- Consumed by: [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) (set-level hybrid sync)
- Network refresh: [fluent-api#309](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/309)
- Unblocks offline first-paint for: [#408](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/408), [#409](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/409)

comments.body:
## Context / why

Fluent Mobile targets low-connectivity regions. Pericope boundaries are **set-scoped** (`project.pericopeSetId`) on fluent-api today, but the only content route is chapter-scoped:

`GET /projects/{id}/pericopes/{bookCode}/{chapter}`

Mobile ticket [fluent-mobile#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) originally planned one call per assigned chapter. That is too expensive (RTT × N). Mobile is moving to a **hybrid**:

1. Seed known FIA/FCBH sets from the APK ([fluent-mobile#447](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/447))
2. Refresh / fetch unknown sets via **one set-level download** with conditional requests

Web can keep using the chapter route on demand. Mobile sync must not.

## Goal

Authenticated (or same auth as `/pericope-sets`) endpoint that returns **all pericope groups for a set** (optional book filter), with **ETag / content version** so clients can send `If-None-Match` and receive **304** when unchanged.

## Proposed contract

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| `GET` | `/pericope-sets/{id}` | Full set payload |
| Optional | `?bookCode=MRK` | Book slice for very large sets |

Response: same group shape as chapter route (`pericopeNumber`, `pericopeTitle`, `verses[]` with possible cross-chapter refs), aggregated for the set (or book).

Headers: strong `ETag` (or documented `version` / `contentHash` field + ETag). Support `If-None-Match` → 304.

Prefer compressible JSON. Do not require N chapter round-trips.

## Out of scope

- Mobile schema/sync/UI (fluent-mobile #438 / #447 / #408)
- Changing chapter route behavior for web
- Bulk-by-assigned-chapters POST (not needed if set-level exists)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /pericope-sets/{id}` returns full set groups (or empty if unknown id — documented)
- [ ] Optional book filter works when implemented
- [ ] ETag (or equivalent) + 304 on conditional revalidate
- [ ] OpenAPI + tests
- [ ] Mobile #438 can hydrate a set in one request

## Related

- Blocks network half of: [fluent-mobile#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438)
- Complements assets: [fluent-mobile#447](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/447)
- Existing domain: `src/domains/pericopes/`

**Sibling fluent-api ticket:** [eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api#309](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/309) — set-level download + ETag (network refresh when set is not in the APK / version mismatches).

Sync consumer: [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438).
